description: Hard modes, stored per game as the languages each is on for, in comma-separated codes. keys: where each game's languages are stored. legacyKeys: the single switch each hard mode was before it went per language. migrations: each game's stored languages after moving those switches over; legacy is the old switches, current what's already stored per language.

migrations.name: a switch that was on turns on for every language
a switch that was off turns on for none
languages already stored win over an old switch
games without an old switch keep what they have
